title: 503 Service Unavailable
description:
RFC 9110 §15.6.4; class server_error; engine use: used.
Trigger: A required model, backend, or dependency is unavailable.
Content: per-operation (per-operation).
Required headers: Retry-After.
Cache-Control: no-store; retry: retry-after.

x-response-contract.trigger: A required model, backend, or dependency is unavailable.

Retry-After.value: Non-negative integer seconds until the caller may retry.
Retry-After.notes: HTTP-date form is not used. Required on 429 and retryable 503.
